allocation.rationale: Graph is IDLE with no active experiment — the most urgent liveness gap — after an 8-streak on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE ending in replicated BLIND_FAILS_AT_HELDOUT_TAU_STAR (audit PASS, no promotion). Marginal value of a 13th resolver parameterization is ~zero: the deterministic-vs-blind fork is decided at the measured boundary (gold-lexicon-conditional, blind fails at held-out tau_star). Decision counterfactual: if a measured h(N)/Cwrite/Cmiss locus shows memory paying for itself above some hit rate, Graph/Product gain a quantitative admission policy and C-PRODUCT-ECON gets its missing denominator; if memory never pays even at high hit rates on matched tasks, the calibrated-memory product path is falsified-in-setting and budget moves to compilation-bypass or adapter work. Strongest fair baseline: cold re-derivation plus empty-registry ablation at matched correctness, never a no-memory strawman. Smallest decisive batch: one matched task family with controlled recurrence at two N points; expand only if the locus is identified. Stop trigger: non-discriminating ceiling (all arms at 1.0) or unmeasurable Cwrite/Cmiss — then PARK, do not re-parameterize the resolver.
